name: Google Calendar
description: Keep your COGNIX[WS] Agenda in step with Google Calendar, both ways: your Google events appear in the Agenda (with alerts and free/busy for agents), and what you add or change in the Agenda goes to Google.

settings.label: OAuth client ID
settings.description: From your Google Cloud project: APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client ID of type Desktop app.

settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.description: The secret of the same Desktop app client.

settings.label: Calendar
settings.description: Which Google calendar to sync. Leave empty for your primary calendar.
